[SWS_UCM_00193] Software Cluster life-cycle state transition from kUpdated to kPresent
⌈
A Software Cluster state shall change from kUpdated
to kPresent after a successful activation of the updated Software Cluster with
Finish method call.
⌋

[SWS_UCM_00193] Software Cluster life-cycle state transition from kUp- dated to kPresent
⌈
A Software Cluster state shall change from kUpdated
to kPresent after a successful activation of the updated Software Cluster with
Finish method call, or after reverting the Software Cluster update with a Re-
vertProcessedSwPackage method call.
⌋

[SWS_UCM_00193] Software Cluster life-cycle state transition from kUpdat- ing to kPresent
⌈
A Software Cluster state shall change from kUpdating to
kPresent after a successful activation of the updated Software Cluster with
Finish method call, or after reverting the Software Cluster update with a Re-
vertProcessedSwPackages method call.
⌋

[SWS_UCM_00193] Software Cluster life-cycle state transition from kUpdat- ing to kPresent
⌈
A Software Cluster state shall change from kUpdating to
kPresent after a successful activation of the updated Software Cluster with
Finish method call, or after reverting the Software Cluster update with a Re-
vertProcessedSwPackages method call.
⌋

[SWS_UCM_00193] Software Cluster life-cycle state transition from kUpdat- ing to kPresent
⌈
A Software Cluster state shall change from kUpdating to kPresent after a
successful activation of the updated Software Cluster with Finish method call, or
after reverting the Software Cluster update with a RevertProcessedSwPack-
ages method call.
⌋

ages method call.
